links.outcome: Readability (FRES, FKRL) of LLM-generated plain-language reports versus original radiology reports
links.effect: Statistically significant improvement in mean FRES and FKRL for radiograph, CT, and MRI reports; mean reading level of all AI-LLM-generated reports improved to below an eighth-grade level.
links.quote: For all AI-LLM-generated reports, the mean reading level improved to below an eighth-grade reading level.

links.outcome: Hallucination rate and accuracy of LLM-generated patient-facing report explanations
links.quote: The hallucination rate in the AI-LLM-generated radiograph report, CT report, and MRI report was 3%, 6%, and 6%, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance (readability, accuracy, and hallucination rate) when simplifying radiology reports for patients using retrospective data without comparing different deployment practices or guardrails.
